name: handoff
description: /handoff writes a structured note (goal, repo, commit, data paths, env vars, open decisions, next step) that the next session in the same repo offers to load

handoffDir.description: Where a Markdown copy of each handoff is written (point it at a synced folder to carry notes between machines). ~ is your home folder
